top_signals.title: Laura Cooper on AI Jitters, Oil and the Fed
top_signals.summary: Laura Cooper of Nuveen discusses AI jitters, rising oil prices and the outlook for Treasury yields and Fed policy. She also explains why investors are becoming more selective on AI and looking toward broader diversification. Cooper spoke on Bloomberg Brief. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Retail Traders Find a Back Door to 24/7 Oil Trading
top_signals.summary: US investors are using VPNs to access offshore platforms, prompting warnings from regulated commodity firms over market risks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Was crypto self-custody ever designed for beginners?
top_signals.summary: Recent hardware wallet security incidents have renewed debate over whether self-custody is suitable for beginners, as multisig and seedless designs carry their own risks.
